youtube.description:
Kiro setup: 5 things to do in your first hour

Five things to do in your first hour with Kiro.

1. Install - Download and sign in.
2. Import your setup - Migrate your VS Code profile.
3. Write steering - Start with product, tech and structure.
4. Pick a mode - Autopilot or Supervised. Your call.
5. Start a spec - Describe a small feature and read the spec.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/getting-started/
